title: Aligning Misaligned Benchmarks for Single-View Novel View Synthesis
abstract: arXiv:2610.38349v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: While single-view novel view synthesis methods have been dramatically enhanced recently, how to quantify their performance has yet to be standardized. In this work, we demonstrate that an important factor lies in how each method's own reference frame is aligned with the so-called ground-truth pose. Existing methods often rely on test-time optimization of target poses for this alignment, which inherently is ill-posed due to the complexity of the optimization landscape of camera poses vs render accuracy, leading to methods being evaluated at an arbitrary local optimum. Some recognize this limitation and thus rely on 3D reconstructions of entire scenes using training and test views to align poses, which may be infeasible. In this work, instead, we propose to use traditional 2D-to-2D and 2D-to-3D image matching techniques to align 3D reconstructions. translated_title: 对齐单视角新视角合成中未对齐的基准
translated_abstract: 尽管单视角新视角合成方法近年来得到了显著提升，但如何量化其性能尚未标准化。在这项工作中，我们证明了一个重要因素在于每个方法自身的参考帧如何与所谓的真值位姿对齐。现有方法通常依赖测试时对目标位姿的优化来实现这种对齐，但由于相机位姿与渲染精度之间优化环境的复杂性，这本质上是一个不适定问题，导致各方法在任意的局部最优解处被评估。一些方法认识到了这一局限性，因此依赖使用训练视图和测试视图对整个场景进行3D重建来对齐位姿，但这可能是不可行的。在这项工作中，我们转而提出使用传统的2D到2D和2D到3D图像匹配技术来对齐3D重建。我们还仅在不同视图之间的共同可见区域内进行评估，这是唯一……
tldr: 该论文提出使用传统的2D到2D和2D到3D图像匹配技术来对齐3D重建，并仅在视图间的共同可见区域内进行评估，从而解决了单视角新视角合成基准中位姿对齐不适定的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes using traditional 2D-to-2D and 2D-to-3D image matching techniques to align 3D reconstructions and evaluating only within co-visible regions, addressing the ill-posed pose alignment problem in single-view novel view synthesis benchmarks.
